_readme: Venues that publish their programme as a monthly poster on Instagram instead of a website.
Two ways to fill one in, and you can mix them:
paste:      the post's caption, copied verbatim. Lines shaped like
'1.9 | שלישי | 20:00 | היומן' or '1.9 | 20:00 | היומן' are read; everything else is ignored.
screenings: explicit entries, for programmes announced as prose rather than a list.
'year' is the year the pasted dates belong to (they carry no year of their own).
